searchText: Can I use `blst_fp12_finalverify` for the KZG proof verification? yes It would be hidden here: https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/blob/main/src/eip4844/eip4844.c#L369 and you would replace what's at the end there by finalverify: https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/blob/main/src/common/utils.c#L184-L187 it would look like this: https://github.com/status-im/nim-blscurve/blob/master/blscurve/blst/blst_min_pubkey_sig_core.nim#L269-L297 Ok, thanks. Although the `blst_fp12_finalverify` is simpler API. It takes two GT points. Not sure why c-kzg didn't use it.
